flor-de-las-antillas--flor-de-las-antill.description: Created by Pepín and Jaime García and launched in 2012, Flor de las Antillas is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro made at My Father Cigars, with a sun-grown Nicaraguan wrapper and a double Nicaraguan binder. Smooth and creamy rather than fiery, it moves from roasted pecan and nougat through coffee and baking spice to dark chocolate, cedar and earth.

thirds.notes: Creamy from the start, led by roasted pecan and nougat, with milk chocolate and floral touches developing.
Baking spice and more sweetness arrive; almond-like nuttiness replaces the pecan over a layer of coffee.
Darker, with bittersweet chocolate and coffee, then cedar, soil, dried berries and measured spice.
